mapper.sql: eo.id, eo.user_id AS userId, eo.runner_id AS runnerId, cu.username AS customerUsername, cu.phone AS customerPhone, ru.username AS runnerUsername, ru.phone AS runnerPhone, eo.order_no AS orderNo, eo.order_type AS orderType, eo.order_type_label AS orderTypeLabel, eo.pickup_method AS pickupMethod, eo.pickup_location AS pickupLocation, eo.pickup_notes AS pickupNotes, eo.delivery_location AS deliveryLocation, eo.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, eo.delivery_pin AS deliveryPin, eo.delivery_proof_status AS deliveryProofStatus, eo.photo_proof_url AS photoProofUrl, eo.photo_proof_note AS photoProofNote, eo.time_window_type AS timeWindowType, eo.time_window_label AS timeWindowLabel, eo.preferred_latest_time AS preferredLatestTime, eo.base_fee AS baseFee, eo.distance_fee AS distanceFee, eo.urgency_fee AS urgencyFee, eo.tip_fee AS tipFee, eo.weekly_card_discount_fee AS weeklyCardDiscountFee, eo.total_fee AS totalFee, eo.points_cost AS pointsCost, eo.status, eo.status_label AS statusLabel, eo.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, eo.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt, eo.customer_confirmed_at AS customerConfirmedAt, eo.points_transferred_at AS pointsTransferredAt, eo.runner_review_score AS runnerReviewScore, eo.review_comment AS reviewComment, eo.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, eo.appeal_status AS appealStatus, eo.appeal_reason AS appealReason, eo.appeal_resolution AS appealResolution, eo.appeal_created_at AS appealCreatedAt, eo.appeal_resolved_at AS appealResolvedAt, eo.created_at AS createdAt, eo.updated_at AS updatedAt
FROM errand_order eo LEFT JOIN `user` cu ON eo.user_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN `user` ru ON eo.runner_id = ru.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_order ( user_id, runner_id, order_no, order_type, order_type_label, pickup_method, pickup_location, pickup_notes, delivery_location, delivery_method, delivery_pin, delivery_proof_status, photo_proof_url, photo_proof_note, time_window_type, time_window_label, preferred_latest_time, base_fee, distance_fee, urgency_fee, tip_fee, weekly_card_discount_fee, total_fee, points_cost, status, status_label, cancel_reason, cancelled_at, customer_confirmed_at, points_transferred_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{runnerId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderType}, #{orderTypeLabel}, #{pickupMethod}, #{pickupLocation}, #{pickupNotes}, #{deliveryLocation}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{deliveryPin}, #{deliveryProofStatus}, #{photoProofUrl}, #{photoProofNote}, #{timeWindowType}, #{timeWindowLabel}, #{preferredLatestTime}, #{baseFee}, #{distanceFee}, #{urgencyFee}, #{tipFee}, #{weeklyCardDiscountFee}, #{totalFee}, #{pointsCost}, #{status}, #{statusLabel}, #{cancelReason}, #{cancelledAt}, #{customerConfirmedAt}, #{pointsTransferredAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE errand_order SET status = #{status}, status_label = #{statusLabel}, delivery_proof_status = #{deliveryProofStatus}, photo_proof_url = #{photoProofUrl}, photo_proof_note = #{photoProofNote}, customer_confirmed_at = #{customerConfirmedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE errand_order SET runner_id = #{runnerId}, status = #{status}, status_label = #{statusLabel}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND runner_id IS NULL AND status = 'PLACED'
mapper.select: SELECT eo.id, eo.user_id AS userId, eo.runner_id AS runnerId, eo.order_no AS orderNo, eo.points_cost AS pointsCost, eo.status, eo.points_transferred_at AS pointsTransferredAt FROM errand_order eo WHERE eo.status = 'DELIVERED' AND eo.runner_id IS NOT NULL AND eo.points_transferred_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE errand_order SET status = 'PLACED', status_label = 'Placed', runner_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND runner_id = #{runnerId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'

UPDATE errand_order SET status = 'CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER', status_label = 'Cancelled by Customer', runner_id = NULL, cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancelled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PLACED', 'ACCEPTED')

UPDATE errand_order SET status = 'DELIVERED', status_label = 'Delivered', delivery_proof_status = 'CUSTOMER_CONFIRMED', customer_confirmed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION'

UPDATE errand_order SET runner_review_score = #{runnerScore}, review_comment = #{comment}, reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELIVERED' AND runner_review_score IS NULL

UPDATE errand_order SET appeal_status = 'OPEN', appeal_reason = #{reason}, appeal_resolution = NULL, appeal_created_at = NOW(), appeal_resolved_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELIVERED' AND appeal_status <> 'OPEN'

UPDATE errand_order SET status = 'DELIVERED', status_label = 'Delivered', delivery_proof_status = 'AUTO_CONFIRMED', customer_confirmed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION' AND updated_at <= #{deadline}
UPDATE errand_order SET points_transferred_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'DELIVERED' AND runner_id IS NOT NULL AND points_transferred_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM errand_order WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} AND status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'PICKED_UP', 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION')
